description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for PerformanceTrackerLog entities in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and modify performance tracker log data, such as getting formatted added and modified dates, and setting related entities like Employee, User, and PerformanceTracker by their IDs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PerformanceTrackerLog entity, providing methods to format dates and set related entities by IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTrackerLog entity.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped PerformanceTrackerLog entity.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the performance tracker log was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the performance tracker log was last modified.

methods.name: setReviewerByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated as reviewer using their employee number.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the User associated with the log using their user ID.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerById
methods.description: Sets the PerformanceTracker associated with the log using its ID.
